item.title: California restores 67 acres farmland into wetlands & grasslands; restored landscape opens Sept 20
item.description: California is restoring 67 acres of former agricultural land at Ensen Community Park in Salinas into wetlands, grasslands and wildlife habitat. The project has reshaped more than 172,000 cubic yards of soil and includes 6,000 native plants, 100 trees, 1.7 miles of trails and three bridges. The restored landscape will open to the public on September 20. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Taiwanese students turn oyster shells and coral waste into 3D-printed reef structures
item.description: Taiwanese students developed Reefvive, using oyster shells and coral gravel for 3D-printed reef bases. These structures provide a stable foundation for coral fragments to grow. Underwater trials showed a perfect survival rate for all attached coral fragments. Marine creatures quickly inhabited the new reef structures, demonstrating their effectiveness. The project aims to make coral restoration more accessible and scalable. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
